pages.text: Beyond every universe, beyond even Hyperdimensional Reality, lies the $(thing)Transcendental$(). The way in is made, not found: with the $(item)Proof of Everything$() and $(thing)Beyond the Omega$() researched, the $(item)Omnilex Engine$() does the impossible and collapses into a five-dimensional $(thing)hyperobject$(). It eats its own structure, then drags in everything nearby; whoever reaches its heart is carried across.

The hyperobject stays where the engine stood, a doorway that pulls only those who come close.$(br2)The first arrival builds the place: a disc of transcendent stone a hundred and twelve blocks across, a Hall of Matter on its pedestals, eight reliquaries holding the controllers of the great machines of the endgame, and a rift back to the Overworld. Carry an $(item)Identity Kernel$().

At its centre, on a dais within eight omnium pillars, stands the $(item)Omnipotence Core$(). Its screen lists every item of every mod installed: $(thing)Materialize$() any of them, as many as a stack, as often as you like.

$(thing)Access denied$(): the Core lists everything of $(thing)this$() mod too, but will not make any of it - ask, and it refuses. Nor does it make what lies beyond Omnipotence, nor the creative items of other mods (only the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$() makes those).$(br2)The Core cannot be broken, and nothing of Omnipotency can be built elsewhere. What comes next is the $(thing)Shutdown Sequence$().
